Match each blank by context:

1. The claimed minimum is \(50\binom{100}{50}\).
2. Binary strings are vectors in \(\mathbb F_2^{100}\).
3. “\(v\subseteq w\)” means every 1 of \(v\) is also a 1 of \(w\).
4–5. \(f(v)\) counts elements in \(\bigcup S_i\) with membership pattern \(v\), i.e. \(x\in S_i\iff v_i=1\).
6–10. Divisibility becomes \(P(u)\), for nonzero \(u\), plus nonempty total intersection, and objective \(A\), over nonnegative integers.
11. Only need \(P(u)\) for \(|u|\ge 50\).
12–18. The extremal construction is \(f_0(v)=2|v|-100\); checking it uses the sum formula for \(|u|=100-k\), giving \((100-k)2^k=|u|2^k\), a multiple of \(|u|\), and objective \(50\binom{100}{50}\).
19–28. Push-down molds toward \(f_0\): choose \(v\) with \(f(v)\ge |v|\), decrease by \(|v|\), increase each immediate predecessor \(w\subseteq v\) with \(|w|=|v|-1\) by 1. This changes \(P(u)\) only for \(u\subseteq v\), with net change \(-|u|\). \(A\) is unchanged for \(|v|>50\), and decreases by 50 when \(|v|=50\).
29–34. Apply push-downs top-down: first on \(1\ldots1\), then \(|v|=99\), then \(|v|=98\), etc., until \(0\le f(v)<|v|\) for all \(|v|=50\).
35–40. Then for all \(50\le |v|\le 100\), \(0\le f(v)<|v|\). By downward induction on \(|v|=99,98,\ldots,50\), we get \(f(v)\equiv f_0(v)\pmod{|v|}\Rightarrow f(v)=f_0(v)\), since \(f_0(v)\) and \(f(v)\) are both \(<|v|\). Hence \(f=f_0\).
